lines: We are the fighting Uruk-hai!
That orc scum is weak and pathetic.
The White Hand bred me for war!
The world will run in fear from the fighting Uruk-hai!
Men are no match for us Uruk-hai.
I won't take orders from any Snaga rats!
I'm bigger, stronger, and smarter than even the best mountain-orc scum.
The Uruk-hai are stronger than all the men in Middle-earth!
I'll be dead before I see the Uruk-hai answer to the likes of you!
Men like you are filthy and weak.
Curse this nasty weather.
You can hardly see through all this filth.
May the White Hand clear this storm!
Pathetic orcs can't even run without this accursed weather.
No matter how many maggots you kill, the Uruk-hai are still stronger.
I won't listen to the likes of you.
You'll always be a filthy maggot to me #p.
Them Uruks of Mordor pale in comparison to the might of Uruk-hai!
What do you want, Morgul rat?
We might serve the same master, but you're still just stinking man-scum.
Not even a hundred of your hill-men could defeat a single Uruk of the White Hand!
I don't understand why Saruman the Wise deals with petty man-scum like you.
Your warriors are weak and pathetic.
Is every man of Dunland born half-trained like you?
Your chieftains promised warriors. They sent us shepherds.
You fight the Uruk-hai!
You can kill an orc, but you're no match for an Uruk!
